address.description: Address is the IP address of the container

app_id.description:
AppID is the ID of the application the container is created from. Empty if the
container has not been created from an application.

app_name.description:
AppName is the name of the application the container is created from. Empty if the
container has not been created from an application.

app_version.description:
AppVersion is the version of the application the container is created from. Empty if the
container has not been created from an application.

architecture.description: Architecture describes the CPU archtitecture the container is using

config.description: Config summarizes the configuration the container uses

boot_activity.description: BootActivity specifies the Android activity which is started by default

boot_package.description: BootPackage specifies the Android application package name which is started by default

devmode.description: DevMode specifies if development mode has been turned on for the container

disable_watchdog.description: DisableWatchdog defines whether the watchdog is disabled

metrics_server.description: MetricsServer specifies a metrics server the container will use

platform.description: Platform specifies the Anbox platform the container is running with

created_at.description: CreatedAt specifies the time at which the container was created

error_message.description: ErrorMessage provides an error message when the container status is set to error.

image_id.description:
ImageID is the ID of the image the container is created from. Empty if the
container has not been created from an image.

image_version.description:
ImageVersion is the version of the image the container is created from. Empty if the
container has not been created from an image.

name.description: Name of the container. Typically in the format "ams-<ID>".

node.description: Node the container is running on

public_address.description:
PublicAddress is the external IP address the container is accessible on (in most
cases the IP of the node it is running on)

resources.description: Resources specifies the resources allocated for the container

cpus.description: CPUs cores assigned to the container

disk-size.description: DiskSize specifies the amount of storage assigned to the container

gpu-slots.description: GPUSlots specifies the number of GPU slots the container got allocated

vpu-slots.description: VPUSlots specifies the number of VPU slots the container

stored_logs.description: StoredLogs lists log files AMS stores for the container.

tags.description: Tags specifies the tags the container has assigned

ContainerService.description:
While NetworkServiceSpec defines what the user requests, ContainerService is what is actually
opened on the container.
ContainerService.title: ContainerService describes a single service the container exposes to the outside world.

expose.description:
Expose defines wether the service is exposed on the public endpoint of the node
or if it is only available on the private endpoint. To expose the service set to
true and to false otherwise.

name.description:
Name gives the container a hint what the exposed port is being used for. This
allows further tweaks inside the container to expose the service correctly.

node_port.description:
NodePort is the port used on the LXD node to map to the service port
If left empty the node port is automatically selected.

node_port_end.description:
NodePortEnd, if specified, denotes the end of the port range on the node starting
at NodePort

port.description: Port is the port the container provides a service on

port_end.description: PortEnd, if specified, denotes the end of the port range starting at Port

protocols.description: List of network protocols (tcp, udp) the port should be exposed for

ContainerStatus.description: ContainerStatus represents the status a container can be in

ContainerType.description: Possible values are: regular, base, unknown
ContainerType.title: ContainerType describes the type of a container.

NetworkProtocol.description: NetworkProtocol describes a specific network protocol like TCP or UDP a ContainerService can use
